description:
HushPine v0.3.0 has 103 patches for PineDrama 47.7.3 (com.ss.android.ttmd.video).

PineDrama stays on 47.7.3. New: List search and tap to top, original sound for saves and Force original dub in other app languages, and no more sign-in walls on a signed-out install. Needs Morphe Manager 2.7.0 or newer.

All 103 patches applied to the supported APK. This bundle ran through a whole-app walk of PineDrama on a signed-in Galaxy S22 with no crash.

Needs Morphe Manager 2.7.0 or newer. Refresh the HushPine source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a PineDrama APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.

### Features

* `List search and tap to top` (on by default) puts a search bar above the History and Favorites lists, on your profile and on the My list tab some accounts have. Type part of a title and it looks through the whole list, loading the rest as it goes. Tap a result to open it. Tapping the tab you're already on, like Dramas in History, also takes that list back to the top. Each half has its own switch in HushPine settings > Profile.

### Changes

* The patches are built with Morphe patcher 2.5.0, the one stable Morphe Manager 2.7.0 and morphe-desktop 2.3.0 ship. The next bundle needs Manager 2.7.0 or newer, or morphe-desktop 2.3.0 from a computer. Older Managers won't load it.
* The release notes on GitHub stop after the update steps now. They no longer end with a Checked list.
* The Feature Gate Lab leaves PineDrama's paid features alone. Gates tied to paid series, subscriptions, Super Fan, LIVE gifts, coins and the like aren't listed any more and can't be saved. A backup or shared profile holding one restores everything else, and a rule saved on one before this stays stored but does nothing.

### Bug Fixes

* Search results show a real tab name when PineDrama's server sends a placeholder like `${drama_tab_name}`. That tab now reads Drama in your app language.
* Saved dramas keep their original sound when PineDrama's app language isn't English. In other languages many dramas play a copy made for that language, with a dub mixed into the sound and subtitles drawn into the picture, and nothing marks it as dubbed. A save used to keep that dub. It now pairs the sharper picture with the sound from PineDrama's own download file, and a batch save does the same.
* `Force original dub` works on those copies too. The sound switches to the original voices from PineDrama's own download file, and the picture stays as it was.
* PineDrama no longer stops a signed-out install at a sign-in page. A new install goes from the age question straight to Home, and a drama you tap in search results opens instead of asking you to sign in. Before, some installs got a sign-in page with no way to close it.
